title: Pesticides and Food: Eating Safely and Sustainably | The Forum at HSPH
summary: Harvard public health panel on pesticide residues, their health effects, the Dirty Dozen and what organic certification allows.

assertions.quote: it did show that on organic food there's less pesticides
the whole concept of organic not using pesticides I just want you to banish that notion
there's very strong evidence for an association between pesticide exposures and Parkinson's disease

verdicts.note: Meta-analyses of occupational and rural cohorts show raised Parkinson's risk with pesticide exposure, notably paraquat.
The review cites studies linking occupational or drift exposure from spraying to higher Parkinson's disease risk.

assertions.quote: we do see those studies all clearly see effects on neurodevelopment whether it's ADHD type symptoms

verdicts.note: Birth cohorts (CHAMACOS, Columbia, Mount Sinai) consistently associate prenatal organophosphate exposure with lower IQ and attention problems.

US birth cohorts (CHAMACOS, two New York cohorts) link maternal organophosphate or cord-blood chlorpyrifos levels to poorer mental development, attention problems and lower IQ at 7, and reviews conclude general-population prenatal exposure likely harms neurodevelopment; a French cohort with lower exposure did not replicate.

EWG reports that in 2016 EPA itself based chlorpyrifos safe levels on epidemiological studies of neurodevelopmental damage in children, finding a far lower protective level than animal data gave; second-hand account.

verdicts.note: Herbicide-tolerant crops raised glyphosate use and drove resistant weeds, while Bt crops cut insecticide use.

assertions.quote: it's already been shown that pesticides and other agricultural chemicals damage all those aspects of our our agricultural ecosystem

verdicts.note: Pesticides are a documented driver of insect and aquatic biodiversity loss and of water contamination.

For glyphosate, EPA found ecological risks to non-target plants, mammals and birds and judged it 'likely to adversely affect' 93% of listed species and 96% of critical habitats; biodiversity harm is supported for this herbicide, water and soil harm are not shown here.
